trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for it directly — follow the roadmap below and it comes last, after 100% completion.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story and cannot be missed — play through the opening and the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable — finish the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the close.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. The last chapter before the finale — finish its missions and the trophy pops at the close.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story — the gold trophy for seeing the campaign through. It pops at the end of the last mission; nothing before it can lock you out of it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions appear in order in your mission log; play it when it unlocks and the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks in the story's order — play it when it appears and the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission like the rest — finish it when it unlocks and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Play the story in order; the trophy pops when this mission is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — finish it when it unlocks and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story in order; the trophy pops when this mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game stats page tracks your percentage across story, activities, collectibles and challenges — use this checklist to clear each category, then mop up whatever the stats page still shows missing. The platinum depends on this one, so save it for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the running total the game tracks. Stunts rack up fastest in free roam between missions, and the counter is cumulative, so every stunt since the start counts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Play one round or one attempt of every activity the game offers — racing, fishing, the shooting range, bowling, the arcade and the rest — and the trophy pops when the last type registers.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (9 activity types)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range grades each challenge, so replay any that fall short of gold until all 42 show gold. Work through them weapon by weapon and check the range's own medal list as you go.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (42 challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race; win one at each and the trophy pops. If a location will not register, re-check its race on the map — the win must be at that location.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (14 locations)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; the key word is different, so spread your wins across the race list rather than replaying one favourite.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (20 races)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are found at the fishing spots; challenge Cal and out-fish him. It is a contest, not a story mission, so you can retry it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end — any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-character mission strands unlock as you meet them; finish every mission in Andy's strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish every mission in Kenton's strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish every mission in Billy's strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are marked on the map as you explore; each strand is a short chain, and finishing 8 of them pops the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (8 strands)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish every mission in Randy's strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish every mission in Tyrone's strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is the one trophy the launch-day lists flag as missable: spots are easy to walk past, and some sit in story areas, so meditate at each spot the moment you find it instead of saving them all for later. The map marks meditation spots once you are near them.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (18 spots)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide (missable flag)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at a specific animal; track it, take the shot, and the trophy pops when the hunt is delivered.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Check the collections screen to see which sets still need cards, then hunt the missing ones.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (3 sets)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are scattered across the map; each one you use counts once, so work through them as you travel rather than in one trip.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (100 locations)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more, and the game tracks them in one list; clear 50 of any kind. The counter is cumulative across the whole game.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (50 challenges)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the heat on through all three robberies — do not let the wanted level drop between shops — and the trophy pops after the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply get into or drive a vehicle you have not seen before and it counts; the total is cumulative, so keep trying new rides as you find them.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (100 vehicles)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies in range and drop five before it ends — a busy shootout is the best place to try.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport by a route that is not the scheduled one — the game recognises the departure when you exit the airfield on your own terms.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhinos are the tanks; the trophy is tied to dealing with them — take one on and survive the encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out with the loot before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a full robbery with an escape after it; finish five and the trophy pops.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (5 vaults)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Intercept a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and get clear of the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total. The map fills in as you travel; visit every named area and the trophy pops when the last one registers.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (52 areas)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (9 gangs)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops when the moment registers.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's front and out the other side — the trophy is for the exit, not the shopping.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley and complete it — the trophy pops on the follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no detail, and the launch-day lists add none yet — the trophy is tied to a partnership moment, so keep playing the story and partner activities and it will come.
sources: PlayStation — official trophy list (description as published)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your choices — the launch-day lists note a count up to 500 — and the trophy pops as those choices accumulate. There is nothing to hunt: just play and choose.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is deliberately vague; the trophy pops on a second attempt at something — retry what fails and it will come.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Another vague one: the trophy is for witnessing something strange out in Leonida. Explore, follow odd map markers and stranger events, and it pops when the moment happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — line up the drive-by, swing, and the trophy pops on the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them through your laundering contacts and the total adds up — $250,000 laundered pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every dollar spent in any shop counts toward the total, so buy gear, clothes and upgrades as you play and the trophy pops at $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go up for sale as you progress; buy each one and the trophy pops when the eighth is yours.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (8 garages)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Take a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it; ten different registrations pop the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (10 vehicles)
